headline: **Samsung Wallet will add USDC transfers** for US Galaxy users as Anchorage bought Routable and more crypto firms sought OCC trust charters. Europe gave licensed firms **three months to unwind unauthorised stablecoins**.
mix_text: 7 partnerships · 6 regulatory actions · 5 launches · 3 licences · 2 funding rounds · 1 M&A deal
highlights: Samsung said on 7 October that eligible US Galaxy users can send USDC from Samsung Wallet from late October, with Bastion and Coinbase as custodians.
Anchorage Digital bought payouts platform Routable on 6 October, while Rain and Modern Treasury applied to the OCC for national trust bank charters on 5 October.
ESMA told MiCA-licensed firms on 8 October to stop serving non-compliant stablecoins and clear remaining exposures within three months.
US credit union regulator NCUA proposed 26 stablecoin reporting fields for call reports on 9 October, after FinCEN withdrew its unhosted-wallet proposal.
Payout rails widened as Polygon plugged TRON's USDT into Open Money Stack and Nium took on fiat off-ramping for RedotPay.

events.title: NCUA proposes stablecoin data fields for credit union call reports
events.summary: The US credit union regulator proposed 26 new call-report fields on payment stablecoin activity, most on custody of keys, others on reserves held for issuers and exposures. It targets March 2027 reporting; comments close 8 December.

events.title: Nium to run fiat payouts for RedotPay's stablecoin users
events.summary: Cross-border payments firm Nium will provide the fiat off-ramp for RedotPay, letting its users turn stablecoins into local currency paid to bank accounts, wallets or cards across a network spanning 190 countries.

events.title: London's IMMIX raises about €3.1m for non-dollar stablecoin FX
events.summary: IMMIX, which converts between stablecoins in different currencies for payment firms, raised roughly €3.1m from Crane Ventures, BTSE and Portfolio Ventures, after an earlier seed led by MassMutual Ventures with Ripple taking part.

events.title: Bringin opens beta of euro business accounts taking stablecoins
events.summary: Bringin began an invite-only beta giving firms in 30 European countries a virtual IBAN with SEPA plus bitcoin, Lightning and stablecoin acceptance and self-custodied keys, running on Lightspark's MiCA-authorised European unit.

events.title: Visa and Abu Dhabi's ADI Foundation agree to explore on-chain payments
events.summary: Visa agreed to explore digital payments and infrastructure for digital asset transactions with ADI Foundation, the ADGM-registered body behind ADI Chain, a stablecoin-focused network aimed at MENA. No products or dates were set.

events.title: ESMA sets three-month wind-down for unauthorised stablecoin services
events.summary: ESMA told national supervisors that MiCA-licensed firms should stop serving EU clients in stablecoins that are not MiCA-compliant, keeping only wind-down services such as selling, withdrawing or safekeeping, with leftover exposure cleared within three months.

events.title: Polygon adds TRON's USDT to its Open Money Stack payments platform
events.summary: Polygon Labs added TRON support to Open Money Stack, so payment firms can take bank, card or cash funds, convert them into USDT on TRON, move it across EVM chains and pay out to bank accounts through a single integration.

events.title: World Liberty and Mesh plan USD1 spending at online merchants
events.summary: Mesh and World Liberty Financial plan to let USD1 holders pay across Mesh's online merchant network, with rollout targeted for this quarter. The plan was announced at Token2049 in Singapore.

events.title: Samsung Wallet to add USDC transfers for 82m US Galaxy devices
events.summary: From late October, eligible US Galaxy users can send USDC from Samsung Wallet, with Bastion as regulated custodian and Coinbase Prime as sub-custodian. Recipients without wallets can be paid in local currency in 60+ countries.

events.title: London's Noah adds $16m, taking stablecoin payments seed to $38m
events.summary: Noah, which links stablecoin settlement to local payment rails, raised a further $16m from Endeit, FJ Labs, LocalGlobe and Felix Capital, lifting its seed round to $38m. The money funds a New York office and a US push.

events.title: Circle and SAP-backed Tereina to bring USDC and EURC to SAP Pay
events.summary: Circle and Tereina, a company backed by SAP, plan to build USDC and EURC into Tereina's payment stack, beginning with SAP Cloud ERP through SAP Pay. Proof-of-value pilots come first; no wider rollout date was set.

events.title: zerohash becomes a Tempo validator and infrastructure partner
events.summary: zerohash joined the validator set of Stripe-backed Tempo and became an infrastructure partner, giving its bank, fintech and brokerage clients access to Tempo stablecoin rails for payouts, payroll and merchant settlement.

events.title: Brale issues Verona's verUSD stablecoin for AI-agent payments
events.summary: Verona launched verUSD, a dollar-backed token for payments by AI agents, issued by Brale on Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and other chains, with reserves at regulated US institutions. Verona cited $100m of launch commitments.

events.title: Ant International pilots HSBC tokenised deposits in the UAE
events.summary: Ant International ran pilot payments on HSBC's Tokenised Deposit Service via its WhaleRTP treasury platform, covering dirham transfers inside the UAE and dollar flows to Hong Kong and Singapore. It is HSBC's first such client in the region.

events.title: Anchorage Digital buys B2B payouts platform Routable
events.summary: Anchorage Digital acquired accounts-payable payouts firm Routable for an undisclosed sum. It will run as Routable by Anchorage Digital and add stablecoin and tokenised-deposit settlement to corporate payout flows in coming quarters.

events.title: VARA sets tougher standards for audits of VASP reserves
events.summary: After reviewing 2025 proof-of-reserve reports, VARA told auditors to confirm that client holdings were backed 1:1 throughout the period, check wallet segregation and flag any lending or pledging of client assets.

events.title: ADGM FSRA consults on DeFi risk management guidance
events.summary: Consultation Paper 5 of 2026 sets out how firms the FSRA authorises should manage risks from DeFi protocols and venues, including governance, due diligence and safeguarding client assets. Comments are due by 30 Nov 2026.

events.title: Eleven firms form Eurøpe Consortium to push Schuman's EURØP
events.summary: eToro, SwissBorg, Coinhouse, DFNS, LCX, RockawayX and others set up a group to widen distribution and use of EURØP, the MiCA euro token from ACPR-authorised Schuman. Joining does not oblige members to list or integrate it.

events.title: US stablecoin card firm Rain seeks OCC trust bank charter
events.summary: Rain, the US stablecoin card issuer (unrelated to Bahrain's Rain), applied to the OCC for an uninsured New York trust bank to custody digital assets and dollars, manage issuer reserves and issue and redeem dollar stablecoins.

events.title: Modern Treasury applies to the OCC for a national trust bank
events.summary: Modern Treasury asked the OCC to charter Modern Treasury National Trust Bank, a limited-purpose bank for federally supervised digital asset custody and related fiat services. It would neither lend nor issue stablecoins.

events.title: FinCEN withdraws unhosted-wallet and crypto-mixer proposals
events.summary: FinCEN pulled its 2020 plan to make banks and money services businesses verify and record transfers with self-hosted wallets, along with its 2023 mixer finding and rule. Neither had been finalised, so current duties stay the same.

events.title: DIMOCO lets merchants take settlement in euro and dollar stablecoins
events.summary: Austrian payment institution DIMOCO now offers merchants payout in EUR and USD stablecoins to a digital wallet, including outside banking hours, using infrastructure from French MiCA CASP Fipto. Checkout is unchanged for shoppers.

events.title: VARA and UAE Financial Intelligence Unit sign crypto-crime MoU
events.summary: The two bodies agreed to share financial intelligence and expertise to fight crime involving virtual assets. The deal is an inter-agency arrangement and adds no new rules for licensed firms.

events.title: Rain MENA FZE receives full VARA licence for exchange and brokerage
events.summary: VARA's register lists an active VASP licence for Rain MENA FZE dated 5 Oct 2026, covering exchange and broker-dealer services for retail as well as institutional clients. Margin trading, part of the earlier approval, is not listed.

events.title: UAE and Moroccan central banks sign MoUs touching stablecoin rules
events.summary: The CBUAE and Bank Al-Maghrib signed two memoranda in Abu Dhabi to study linking instant payment systems and card switches, share CBDC know-how for cross-border use and cooperate on crypto-asset and stablecoin regulation.

events.title: Community bankers sue the OCC over crypto trust charters
events.summary: The ICBA sued the OCC in federal court in Washington, arguing it went beyond its powers by chartering trust banks that do no fiduciary work. The OCC has approved at least 13 crypto firms for trust charters.

events.title: Treasury sets process for certifying state stablecoin regimes
events.summary: Treasury issued an interim final rule, effective at once, setting forms, cure and appeal steps for the committee that certifies state stablecoin regimes, ahead of the January 2028 deadline.

events.title: AllUnity launches USDAU, a MiCA-compliant dollar stablecoin
events.summary: AllUnity released its fourth token, USDAU, on six chains including Ethereum, Solana, Base and Tempo, giving EU firms dollar liquidity within MiCA. Banking Circle holds the reserves and provides transaction banking.

events.title: ESMA urges explicit MiCA curbs on non-compliant stablecoins
events.summary: In its response to the European Commission's MiCA review, ESMA asked for explicit rules barring regulated crypto firms from serving stablecoins that do not meet MiCA, and for stronger powers over non-EU firms soliciting EU clients.

events.title: Citi and Coinbase widen tie-up on corporate stablecoin payments
events.summary: Coinbase will use Citi's virtual account wallet to convert fiat to stablecoins automatically, while Citi clients can accept stablecoin payments with Coinbase handling the rails and conversion, starting in the US.

events.title: Shiga unveils USDT wallet products for Africa and Gulf on Tether kit
events.summary: Tether-backed Shiga unveiled ENTA for consumers and businesses and Pulse for banks and fintechs, built on Tether's Wallet Development Kit, offering self-custodial USDT, bitcoin and XAUT wallets and corridor settlement in Africa and the GCC.

events.title: Monerium and Bermuda launch private on-chain bank payments
events.summary: Monerium mints EURe from the sender's bank account and redeems into the recipient's SEPA account, while Bermuda routes payments through shielded accounts with zero-knowledge compliance proofs, aimed at corporate flows into Europe.

events.title: Federal Reserve proposes GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers
events.summary: The Fed issued two proposals: reserve, capital and risk rules for stablecoin issuers it supervises, and an application and appeal process for state member banks that want to issue. Comments run for 60 days.

events.title: MoonPay agrees to acquire broker-dealer group North Capital
events.summary: MoonPay signed a merger agreement for North Capital, which runs SEC-registered broker-dealers and the PPEX alternative trading system, to expand into tokenised securities. Terms were not disclosed and approvals are pending.

events.title: Binance buys $100m of Circle shares and renews USDC deal
events.summary: Binance agreed to buy $100m of Circle Class A shares in a private placement and hold them for up to two years. The pair also signed a new five-year agreement to grow USDC use, chiefly in emerging markets.

events.title: Report: Saudi central bank has left the mBridge CBDC platform
events.summary: The FT reported that SAMA has left mBridge, the shared-ledger cross-border CBDC platform. It joined in June 2024 and stopped taking part after a proof of concept in May 2025, and says the exit was planned.

events.title: OCC conditionally approves Bastion, Agora and Catena trust banks
events.summary: The OCC conditionally approved three digital-asset national trust banks: a conversion of Bastion's New York trust and new charters for Agora and Catena Labs. Agora plans to move AUSD issuance into its bank.

events.title: CBUAE says five dirham stablecoin projects are in progress
events.summary: The CBUAE's chief fintech officer said four bank-linked and one non-bank AED stablecoin projects are progressing, and that a consultation on improving the payment token rules is coming soon.

events.title: Circle opens Arc mainnet with BlackRock and Visa among validators
events.summary: Circle launched the public mainnet of Arc, its layer-1 chain with fees paid in USDC, with founding validators including BlackRock, Visa and Mastercard. It minted 10bn ARC tokens without committing to a public token launch.

events.title: Fasset says it will be first VARA-regulated venue to list DDSC
events.summary: Fasset said it will list the DDSC dirham stablecoin once VARA approves the token, using the CBUAE no-objection certificate that lets DDSC be distributed on selected VARA-regulated platforms.

events.title: Network International pilots in-store DDSC payments
events.summary: Shoppers with DDSC wallets can pay by scanning a QR code on Network's POS terminals at Marks & Spencer in Dubai Festival City and LuLu in Abu Dhabi. Merchants can settle in DDSC or dirhams.

events.title: Circle agrees to buy Singapore cross-border payments firm Tazapay
events.summary: Circle signed a definitive agreement to acquire Tazapay, a Singapore B2B cross-border payments platform. Completion is expected in 2027, subject to conditions including approval by the Monetary Authority of Singapore.

events.title: MoonPay Europe wins Dutch e-money licence covering stablecoins
events.summary: DNB granted MoonPay Europe an e-money licence for payment accounts and stablecoin issuance. Combined with its AFM MiCA CASP status, it can now issue euro stablecoins across the EEA.

events.title: Fuze expands to Switzerland after joining an AML self-regulator
events.summary: Fuze's Swiss entity was admitted to SO-FIT, a FINMA-authorised self-regulatory body, so it can offer institutional brokerage, OTC trading and stablecoin settlement alongside SWIFT, SEPA and SIC.

events.title: Copper CEO to depart as sale bids reportedly near $200M
events.summary: CoinDesk reports CEO Amar Kuchinad is leaving custody and settlement firm Copper, whose sale has been marketed by Cantor Fitzgerald at $500M since at least May while offers have reportedly come in around $200M.

events.title: OpenPayd folds in MSB USA and its 43 state money transmitter licences
events.summary: OpenPayd's founder is merging Texas-based MSB USA into the company, adding 43 US state money transmitter licences and US payment routing ahead of the planned Nasdaq listing.

events.title: Utila connects unlicensed fintechs to regulated stablecoin partners
events.summary: Utila lets fintechs without their own licences launch stablecoin payment and custody products through regulated partners via one integration, starting with France's Fipto (MiCA CASP), CoinGate and North American custodians.

events.title: OpenPayd connects to Circle Payments Network
events.summary: OpenPayd joined Circle Payments Network so clients can send cross-border fiat payments that settle in USDC or EURC within seconds, starting with euro to real and sterling to peso corridors.

events.title: Revolut rolls out euro stablecoin EURR issued by Bridge
events.summary: Revolut began a phased rollout of EURR to customers in Denmark, Poland and Portugal. The euro token is issued by Bridge's CSSF-licensed Luxembourg entity, which manages the reserves; wider EEA availability is planned this year.

events.title: Zand to support Circle's USDC alongside its dirham stablecoin
events.summary: Zand plans to add USDC so eligible businesses can use it together with Zand's AED stablecoin for payments, settlement, treasury and cross-border flows, subject to regulatory and market conditions.

events.title: Fasset hits $1bn valuation with $68m Series C led by SBI
events.summary: Japan's SBI Group led a $68m round valuing Fasset at $1bn, taking its 2026 total to $119m. Funds go to its corridor banking network and AI tools for stablecoin settlement and tokenised assets.

events.title: BitGo Europe gets direct mint access to AllUnity stablecoins
events.summary: BitGo Europe, the BaFin-registered CASP of NYSE-listed BitGo, can now mint and redeem AllUnity's MiCA-compliant EURAU, CHFAU and SEKAU directly, giving its clients on-demand liquidity for settlement, treasury and trading.

events.title: MoonPay launches Enterprise suite for stablecoin payments
events.summary: Built on the Iron platform it acquired, MoonPay Enterprise offers virtual accounts, multi-currency treasury, fiat-to-stablecoin conversion and cross-border payouts through a single API.

events.title: Mastercard closes its up-to-$1.8B purchase of BVNK
events.summary: Mastercard closed its purchase of UK-based stablecoin infrastructure firm BVNK after regulatory approvals were met. Agreed in March, the deal is worth up to $1.8B: $1.5B upfront and up to $300M in performance-linked payments.

events.title: Ripple and OpenFX invest in Schuman in euro-rails tie-up
events.summary: Ripple, OpenFX and others made an undisclosed investment in Schuman as part of a deal giving them access to euro rails, with EURØP added to the XRPL permissioned DEX for on-chain FX.

events.title: Emirates lets UAE residents pay for flights with Crypto.com Pay
events.summary: Eligible UAE residents can now pay for Emirates bookings with Crypto.com Pay, with fares priced and settled in dirhams. Crypto.com holds a CBUAE stored value facilities licence.

events.title: TD to custody reserves behind Stablecorp's QCAD
events.summary: TD Bank Group will hold the fiat reserves backing QCAD Digital Trust, phased in over the second half of 2026, one of the first cases of a major Canadian bank acting as a stablecoin reserve custodian.

events.title: Stripe and Advent make a $53bn approach for PayPal
events.summary: Stripe and Advent International offered roughly $53bn, or $60.50 a share, for PayPal with about $50bn of committed financing. PayPal's board was reported to see the offer as too low, and the bidders later walked away.

events.title: Circle wins final OCC approval for its national trust bank
events.summary: The OCC gave final approval for Circle's national trust bank, to operate as Circle National Trust. It will start with digital asset custody for Circle and could later manage USDC reserves.

events.title: Ripple's MiCA CASP approval made final, opening all 30 EEA markets
events.summary: Luxembourg's CSSF upgraded Ripple's June preliminary approval to full MiCA crypto-asset service provider authorisation, so Ripple can sell its regulated crypto payments product to institutions and businesses in all 30 EEA countries.

events.title: CBUAE clears DDSC for listing on VARA-regulated exchanges
events.summary: A central bank no-objection certificate lets DDSC go live on selected VARA-regulated platforms, opening it to retail buying, redemption and dirham payments. Over AED 150m had been transacted in DDSC by then.

events.title: Standard Chartered offers USDC minting and redemption from the DIFC
events.summary: Standard Chartered and Circle launched bank-led USDC minting and redemption for institutional clients, starting with the bank's DIFC operations, for uses such as on-chain settlement and treasury.

events.title: Stripe's Bridge wins MiCA CASP and EMI licences in Luxembourg
events.summary: The CSSF authorised Bridge Building S.A. as a MiCA crypto-asset service provider and e-money institution, so Bridge can offer euro accounts with named IBANs and help businesses issue their own euro stablecoins across the EU.

events.title: MiCA grace period ends with USDT still unauthorised in the EU
events.summary: MiCA's transitional period for crypto firms ended on 1 July 2026 with Tether still not seeking EU authorisation for USDT, which The Paypers reports is gone from regulated EU exchanges; Tether objects to rules forcing large EU bank deposit reserves.

events.title: Orbital plans Miami-led US entry for stablecoin payments
events.summary: Orbital set out a phased US launch from Miami aimed at PSPs, remittance and crypto firms, and plans to seek state money transmission licences over the next 12 to 18 months.

events.title: Banking Circle gives Bridge local euro and sterling payment rails
events.summary: Banking Circle is supplying Stripe's Bridge with multi-currency accounts, local clearing access and SWIFT dollar transfers, helping Bridge clients convert between stablecoins and local currencies such as euros and sterling.

events.title: Zodia Custody gains CSSF payment licence for EU stablecoin custody
events.summary: Luxembourg's CSSF granted Zodia Custody a payment institution licence on top of its MiCA authorisation, allowing it to offer regulated custody and transfers of e-money tokens (stablecoins) across the EU.

events.title: Visa and Brale test private stablecoin settlement on Canton
events.summary: Brale and Visa started a proof of concept settling in Brale's dollar stablecoin SBC on the Canton Network to test privacy-preserving institutional settlement. Visa will weigh SBC as an extra settlement option.

events.title: AX Coin becomes first licensed stablecoin issuer in Bahrain
events.summary: The CBB licensed AX Coin, a unit of Nasdaq-listed SOLOWIN (AXG), to issue stablecoins; the company says it is the first firm licensed under the 2025 issuance module. The peg currency was not disclosed.

events.title: OpenPayd agrees SPAC merger with Titan for a Nasdaq listing
events.summary: OpenPayd agreed to combine with Titan Acquisition Corp at a pro forma equity value near $1.15bn, with up to $276m of trust proceeds. It would trade on Nasdaq, with closing expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.

events.title: OpenPayd secures MiCA CASP authorisation from Malta's MFSA
events.summary: Malta's MFSA authorised OpenPayd as a MiCA crypto-asset service provider shortly before the 1 July 2026 transition deadline, letting it passport stablecoin on- and off-ramping across the EEA.

events.title: IHC moves AED 110m in DDSC on ADI Chain
events.summary: IHC executed an AED 110m (≈$30m) transfer in DDSC, which it called one of the region's largest single stablecoin transactions, marking a shift from pilots to live institutional use of the dirham token.

events.title: Qivalis euro stablecoin consortium grows to 37 banks
events.summary: Twenty-five more lenders, including ABN AMRO, Intesa Sanpaolo, Nordea and Rabobank, joined Qivalis, taking the group to 37 banks. It has applied to the Dutch central bank for an e-money licence and targets a H2 2026 launch.

events.title: Zodia backers accept Standard Chartered bid for custody unit
events.summary: Zodia's shareholders and noteholders accepted Standard Chartered's non-binding offer for the regulated custody arm, which will join the bank's securities services unit. The infrastructure side becomes Zodia Solutions under SC Ventures.

events.title: zerohash adds Dutch e-money licence to its MiCA authorisation
events.summary: De Nederlandsche Bank granted zerohash europe an e-money institution licence, which the firm says makes it the first MiCA-licensed company with EMI status, firming up the legal basis for its stablecoin payment flows in the EEA.

events.title: Fasset raises $51m Series B for stablecoin-based banking
events.summary: Fasset, which holds a Dubai VARA broker-dealer licence, raised $51m from SBI Group, Arz Portföy, Investcorp and family offices to expand its banking corridors and add lending and trade finance.

events.title: USDU and AE Coin plan automated dollar-dirham token conversion
events.summary: An MoU between USDU's issuer, AE Coin and Al Maryah Community Bank aims to build near-instant conversion between the USD and AED payment tokens, with first access via custodian Changer and broker Aquanow.

events.title: Rain's Dubai arm wins VARA in-principle approval
events.summary: Rain MENA FZE got in-principle approval from Dubai's VARA for exchange, broker-dealer and margin trading services, adding a Dubai path to Rain's existing CBB and ADGM licences.

events.title: MoonPay buys Solana trade router DFlow in a stock deal
events.summary: MoonPay acquired DFlow, a Solana trade router and DEX aggregator, for a reported $100m in stock, its sixth acquisition since early 2025, adding trading to its payments stack.

events.title: Tetra launches CADD Canadian-dollar stablecoin
events.summary: Tetra Trust launched CADD, a one-to-one Canadian-dollar stablecoin approved by Alberta's finance ministry, on Ethereum, Base and Tempo, with backers including Wealthsimple, Shopify, National Bank and ATB.

events.title: Western Union launches USDPT stablecoin issued by Anchorage
events.summary: Western Union launched USDPT, a dollar stablecoin on Solana issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, for treasury and agent settlement, starting in the Philippines and Bolivia. Fireblocks provides the wallet infrastructure.

events.title: Bank-backed euro stablecoin venture Qivalis picks Fireblocks
events.summary: Amsterdam-based Qivalis, formed by twelve European banks including BNP Paribas, ING and UniCredit, chose Fireblocks for issuance, custody and compliance tooling for its MiCA euro stablecoin, due in H2 2026 subject to DNB approval.

events.title: Circle France wins AMF approval for MiCA custody and transfers
events.summary: The AMF cleared Circle's French entity under MiCA to offer custody and transfer services for USDC and EURC, which it can passport across the EEA. The AMF register records the licence date as 23 April.

events.title: Banking Circle gets CSSF MiCA licence and adds stablecoin settlement
events.summary: Luxembourg's CSSF authorised Banking Circle as a MiCA CASP. The bank followed with round-the-clock fiat-stablecoin conversion and settlement in USDC, USDG and its own EURI.

events.title: Quantoz adds zloty and sterling e-money tokens
events.summary: Quantoz launched PLNQ and GBPQ on Ethereum, bringing it to five regulated tokens, with Zodia Markets supporting initial OTC distribution.

events.title: ClearBank Europe gains MiCA clearance and plugs into Circle Mint
events.summary: ClearBank Europe says it is the first Dutch credit institution cleared by the AFM for MiCA crypto services, and will connect to Circle Mint so institutional clients can access EURC and USDC.

events.title: FinCEN and OFAC propose AML rules for stablecoin issuers
events.summary: A joint proposal would treat permitted stablecoin issuers as BSA financial institutions with AML and sanctions programmes, able to block or freeze transactions, with a $5,000 suspicious activity threshold.

events.title: FDIC proposes prudential rules for bank stablecoin units
events.summary: The FDIC proposed GENIUS Act standards for stablecoin subsidiaries of its banks, including full reserves, redemption within two days and a $5m capital floor, and a presumption against yield paid via affiliates.

events.title: Coinbase wins conditional OCC approval for a national trust company
events.summary: Coinbase received conditional OCC approval for Coinbase National Trust Company, bringing its institutional custody business under federal supervision. The trust will not take retail deposits.

events.title: Canada's Stablecoin Act becomes law with Bank of Canada oversight
events.summary: Bill C-15, carrying the Stablecoin Act, received Royal Assent, giving the Bank of Canada supervisory, registry and penalty powers. Issuers face par redemption, segregated reserves and a ban on paying yield.

events.title: Tempo mainnet goes live with a protocol for AI-agent payments
events.summary: Tempo switched on its payments layer-1 mainnet and published the open-source Machine Payments Protocol, co-written with Stripe, for payments by AI agents. Visa, Stripe and Lightspark extended it to other rails.

events.title: PayPal opens PYUSD to users in 70 markets
events.summary: PayPal made its PYUSD stablecoin available in accounts across 70 markets, letting users buy, hold, send and receive it and cash out to local currency. Early markets included the US, the UK and several Latin American countries.

events.title: Mastercard agrees to buy BVNK for up to $1.8B
events.summary: Mastercard signed a definitive deal for the London stablecoin infrastructure firm, worth up to $1.8B including $300M in contingent payments, months after BVNK’s talks with Coinbase collapsed.

events.title: VersaBank starts US pilot of USDVB tokenised deposits
events.summary: VersaBank began an internal US pilot of USDVB, the dollar version of its tokenised bank deposits, and refreshed its Canadian-dollar pilot as it moves the product towards commercial use.

events.title: Yuno adds Conduit's stablecoin rails for its merchants
events.summary: Payments orchestrator Yuno made Conduit's stablecoin rails available to merchants within their existing integrations, offering settlement in roughly 15 to 20 minutes and virtual dollar, euro and sterling accounts.

events.title: Visa and Bridge target 100+ countries for stablecoin-backed cards
events.summary: Visa and Stripe's Bridge widened their stablecoin-backed card product, live in 18 countries, aiming for over 100 by year-end with Europe and the Middle East among target regions. Bridge also underpins on-chain settlement in Visa's pilot.

events.title: AllUnity launches CHFAU Swiss franc stablecoin
events.summary: AllUnity issued CHFAU, a fully reserved Swiss franc e-money token aligned with MiCA, on Ethereum, with more chains planned during 2026.

events.title: OCC proposes GENIUS Act rules for the issuers it oversees
events.summary: The OCC proposed GENIUS Act rules for federal and foreign issuers it supervises, requiring one-to-one liquid reserves, tailored capital and liquidity, and redemption at par within two business days.

events.title: Quantoz becomes a Visa principal member for stablecoin cards
events.summary: Quantoz Payments joined Visa as a principal member, allowing it to issue virtual Visa debit cards that spend e-money and stablecoin balances and to sponsor BINs for European fintechs.

events.title: BVNK wins MiCA CASP licence from Malta's MFSA
events.summary: Malta's financial regulator granted stablecoin payments firm BVNK a MiCA crypto-asset service provider licence, letting it serve the EEA from Malta, where it already held e-money authorisation and now pairs crypto services with direct SEPA access.

events.title: Stripe's Bridge wins conditional OCC trust bank approval
events.summary: The OCC conditionally approved Bridge, owned by Stripe, to form a national trust bank that could issue stablecoins, hold custody and manage reserves under federal oversight.

events.title: Zodia Markets joins BCB's BLINC instant settlement network
events.summary: Zodia Markets went live on BCB's round-the-clock BLINC network and became a liquidity provider to BCB's OTC desk. BCB also flagged dirham settlement rails for Middle East corridors.

events.title: CBUAE approves launch of DDSC dirham stablecoin on ADI Chain
events.summary: IHC, FAB and Sirius received central bank approval to go live with DDSC, a dirham-backed token on the ADI Chain layer-2 network, aimed at institutional payments, high-value settlement, treasury and trade flows.

events.title: Zand and Ripple explore links between AEDZ and RLUSD stablecoins
events.summary: Zand plans to support custody of Ripple's RLUSD and will explore direct liquidity between RLUSD and its dirham token AEDZ, plus issuing AEDZ on the XRP Ledger. All steps are exploratory and need regulatory approval.

events.title: Tether invests $100m in Anchorage Digital at $4.2bn valuation
events.summary: Tether took a $100m strategic equity stake in Anchorage Digital at a $4.2bn valuation, pointing to its use of the bank for USAT issuance, custody and compliance.

events.title: Bitpanda joins Global Dollar Network and lists MiCA-compliant USDG
events.summary: Bitpanda opened USDG trading, deposits and withdrawals for European users. In the EU the token is issued by Paxos Issuance Europe under Finnish supervision and redeemable one-for-one for dollars.

events.title: VersaBank signs QCAD as first stablecoin reserve custody client
events.summary: VersaBank agreed to custody reserves for Stablecorp's QCAD on its VersaVault platform, earning fees on assets held, replacing Tetra Trust as QCAD's reserve custodian.

events.title: NymCard claims GCC first with USDC settlement on Visa
events.summary: Card issuer NymCard launched USDC settlement with Visa and says it is the first issuer in the GCC to do so. Settling in a stablecoin lets it settle around the clock and cuts the collateral and prefunding it must hold.

events.title: Luxembourg's CSSF grants Ripple a full EU e-money licence
events.summary: The CSSF confirmed Ripple's electronic money institution licence weeks after a conditional green light, giving Ripple an EU-regulated base from which to expand Ripple Payments across the bloc.

events.title: CBUAE registers USDU as the first Foreign Payment Token
events.summary: The central bank registered USDU, a dollar stablecoin from ADGM-regulated Universal Digital, under its payment token rules; CoinDesk calls it the first USD token cleared this way. Aquanow is a distribution partner outside the UAE.

events.title: Mesh raises $75m Series C at $1bn valuation led by Dragonfly
events.summary: Crypto payments network Mesh closed a $75m Series C led by Dragonfly, valuing it at $1bn and taking total funding past $200m. Part of the round was settled in stablecoins.

events.title: Tether's US stablecoin USAT launches with Anchorage as issuer
events.summary: Tether's US-focused stablecoin USAT began trading on Kraken, Crypto.com and other venues, issued by OCC-supervised Anchorage Digital Bank, with Cantor Fitzgerald holding the reserves.

events.title: Ripple and Riyad Bank's Jeel sign MoU on blockchain payments
events.summary: Ripple agreed with Jeel, the innovation unit of Riyad Bank, to study blockchain use in cross-border payments, digital asset custody and tokenisation. Stablecoins were not named in the scope.

events.title: Swift and SG-FORGE settle tokenised bonds using EURCV
events.summary: Swift orchestrated the issue, delivery-versus-payment, coupons and redemption of tokenised bonds across chains and fiat rails, using SG-FORGE's framework and its EUR CoinVertible token with ISO 20022 messaging.

events.title: ClearBank picks Taurus wallet tech to support stablecoin services
events.summary: UK bank ClearBank, which also has an ECB-authorised Dutch arm, chose Taurus-PROTECT as wallet infrastructure for client stablecoin services; Taurus also connects to Circle Mint for minting and redeeming USDC and EURC.

events.title: Ripple wins UK e-money licence and FCA cryptoasset registration
events.summary: The FCA granted Ripple an electronic money institution licence and cryptoasset registration, allowing it to scale Ripple Payments so UK institutions can move cross-border payments using digital assets.

events.title: RAKBANK gets in-principle nod for a dirham-backed stablecoin
events.summary: The CBUAE gave RAKBANK in-principle approval to issue a stablecoin backed 1:1 by segregated dirham reserves. Ledger Insights calls it the first conventional UAE bank to get this far; launch still needs final sign-off.

events.title: Network International to accept AE Coin at POS and online checkouts
events.summary: Network signed an MoU with Al Maryah Community Bank to add AE Coin as a payment method on its in-store and e-commerce platforms, which it calls a first for a UAE payments processor. No rollout date was set.

events.title: FDIC proposes how banks apply to issue stablecoins
events.summary: The FDIC board proposed a GENIUS Act rule on how the banks it supervises apply to issue payment stablecoins through subsidiaries, covering activities, ownership and control, and audit requirements.

events.title: DFSA scraps recognised token list; firms must judge suitability
events.summary: From 12 Jan 2026, firms in the DIFC must assess and document whether each crypto token is suitable, rather than rely on a DFSA list. Fiat crypto tokens (stablecoins) remain under a separate DFSA policy statement.

events.title: OCC conditionally approves five crypto national trust banks
events.summary: The OCC conditionally approved new national trust banks for Circle and Ripple and conversions for BitGo, Fidelity Digital Assets and Paxos. The charters exclude deposit-taking and carry capital and governance conditions.

events.title: ADNOC Distribution signs MoU to accept AE Coin payments
events.summary: The fuel retailer agreed with Al Maryah Community Bank to let customers pay in AE Coin through the AEC Wallet at its service stations, Oasis stores and car washes. No go-live date was given.

events.title: ADGM extends USDT acceptance to nine more blockchains
events.summary: Abu Dhabi's FSRA recognised USDT as an Accepted Fiat-Referenced Token on nine more networks, including TRON, TON and Aptos, on top of Ethereum, Solana and Avalanche, so ADGM-licensed firms can use it in regulated activities.

events.title: Ten-bank euro stablecoin venture named Qivalis, eyes H2 2026
events.summary: European banks including ING, UniCredit and BNP Paribas named their Amsterdam stablecoin joint venture Qivalis, appointed a CEO and chair, and said they had applied to DNB for an e-money licence ahead of a 2026 launch.

events.title: Conduit launches multicurrency accounts for fiat and stablecoins
events.summary: Conduit rolled out virtual accounts and IBANs in dollars, euros and sterling, with pay-ins and payouts in 15 fiat currencies plus USDT and USDC, for clients in more than 100 countries.

events.title: Sony Bank picks Bastion to issue its planned dollar stablecoin
events.summary: Sony Financial Group chose Bastion to handle issuance, reserves and custody for a dollar stablecoin planned by Sony Bank's proposed US trust bank, Connectia Trust, aimed at treasury and in-app payments.

events.title: Abu Dhabi's FSRA accepts RLUSD for use by ADGM-licensed firms
events.summary: ADGM's regulator recognised Ripple's RLUSD as an Accepted Fiat-Referenced Token, so FSRA-authorised firms can use it in regulated activities. It builds on approvals RLUSD had already won from other regulators in the region.

events.title: Deutsche Börse signs MoU to integrate AllUnity's EURAU
events.summary: Deutsche Börse agreed to bring AllUnity's euro stablecoin into its market infrastructure, starting with institutional custody at Clearstream, with Crypto Finance (Germany) acting as sub-custodian.

events.title: Visa adds Aquanow to bring stablecoin settlement to CEMEA clients
events.summary: Visa partnered with Aquanow, which holds a Dubai VARA licence, so issuers and acquirers in Central and Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa can settle with Visa in approved stablecoins such as USDC, every day of the year.

events.title: Paxos acquires MPC wallet and custody provider Fordefi
events.summary: Paxos bought Fordefi, an institutional MPC wallet and custody platform with offices in New York and Tel Aviv, to build out its custody layer. Terms were not disclosed.

events.title: Canadian regulators clear QCAD stablecoin prospectus
events.summary: Canadian securities regulators receipted the final prospectus of QCAD Digital Trust, allowing distribution of the Canadian-dollar stablecoin run by Stablecorp, which calls it the first regulator-approved CAD coin.

events.title: Deutsche Börse to integrate SG-FORGE's CoinVertible stablecoins
events.summary: Deutsche Börse, Société Générale and SG-FORGE agreed to bring EUR and USD CoinVertible into market infrastructure, starting with collateral and settlement at Clearstream, with listing on group venues planned.

events.title: CBUAE clears Zand to launch multi-chain dirham stablecoin
events.summary: Zand won central bank approval for Zand AED, a dirham stablecoin issued by its subsidiary Zand Trust on several public blockchains and backed 1:1 by segregated AED reserves. Zand bills it as the UAE's first of its kind.

events.title: BVNK and Coinbase call off takeover after due diligence
events.summary: Coinbase and UK stablecoin payments firm BVNK mutually ended talks on a deal valued around $2B after reaching due diligence; BVNK, which says it handles over $20B a year, had also discussed a sale with Mastercard.

events.title: Canada's Budget 2025 proposes a federal stablecoin law
events.summary: Canada's 2025 federal budget announced legislation for fiat-backed stablecoin issuers, with the Bank of Canada as overseer, covering reserves, redemption and risk management, plus about C$10m over two years to run it.

events.title: Dutch AFM authorises zerohash under MiCA for EEA-wide services
events.summary: The AFM authorised zerohash europe as a MiCA crypto-asset service provider, letting the US infrastructure firm provide embedded crypto and stablecoin services to business clients across the EEA from the Netherlands.

events.title: New UAE central bank law pulls crypto payments into CBUAE licensing
events.summary: CoinDesk reported that Federal Decree Law No. 6 of 2025, enacted in Sept and made public in Nov, extends CBUAE licensing to virtual-asset payments, DeFi and related infrastructure, giving existing firms until Sept 2026 to comply.

events.title: SG-FORGE authorised as a MiCA crypto-asset service provider
events.summary: France's AMF register lists SG-FORGE as a MiCA CASP for custody and transfers from 23 October 2025, with order execution added by extension in February 2026.

events.title: Stripe-incubated Tempo raises $500m at $5bn valuation
events.summary: Payments blockchain Tempo, incubated by Stripe and Paradigm, raised a $500m Series A at a $5bn valuation led by Thrive Capital and Greenoaks. Stripe and Paradigm did not invest in the round.

events.title: Saudi minister says stablecoins are under discussion with SAMA and CMA
events.summary: Housing minister Majid Al-Hogail said the government is discussing stablecoins with the central bank and the Capital Market Authority. Unlock reported this as talks, not a decision.
